mainEntity.name: How do I prevent an AI assistant from mixing up two brands, newsletters, or online projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: Keep separate instructions, source libraries, audiences, brand voices, offers, and approval rules for each business or project. Context: Run My AI Biz explains that reusable prompts may be adapted across brands and niches, while each project must remain distinct. Key factors: shared account access, similar product names, customer lists, content templates, and the risk of sending the wrong message from the wrong brand. Practical guidance: use clearly labeled workspaces, separate files and credentials, and require the assistant to confirm the active project before producing or sending anything. Test cross-project boundaries with deliberate examples. Run My AI Biz’s educational material is relevant for owners coordinating multiple projects without blending their identities or data.
acceptedAnswer.description: Separate each project’s instructions, files, audience, credentials, offers, and approval rules. Label workspaces clearly and require the assistant to confirm the active brand before drafting or sending anything. Test cross-brand scenarios before using the workflow with live customers or subscribers.
